author_source: project/高校实验室安全/011_人因与事故致因/src.py

points.K4: 专注：别一边看手机一边操作
points.K5: 关注人的因素：疲劳和马虎
points.K10: 差错是系统问题的症状
points.K11: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
points.S1: 事故金字塔：险情是事故的预告
points.K14: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
points.K15: 按人的特点设计：防错设计

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一块被打翻了一角的多米诺骨牌阵旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of dominoes with the first few toppled and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲人因与事故致因。

shots.scene: 三个图标：人脑、漏洞重叠的奶酪片、冰山
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a human brain, stacked cheese slices with holes, and an iceberg. No people.
shots.narration: 人为什么会犯错，事故怎么发生。

shots.scene: 阿杰手忙脚乱，桌上三个计时器同时响，他抓起一瓶试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is flustered as three timers ring at once on his bench; he grabs a reagent bottle in a hurry.
shots.narration: 阿杰今天忙得团团转。

shots.scene: 他拿错了瓶子，正要倒进烧杯，小研伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: He picked the wrong bottle and is about to pour it into a beaker when the female graduate student stops his hand.
shots.narration: 差一点，就倒错了试剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头歪头思考
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot tilts its head thoughtfully at the camera.
shots.narration: 只怪阿杰粗心吗？没那么简单。

shots.section_title: 人都会犯错，越忙越要守规矩
shots.scene: 实验室里人人忙碌，安全图标被挤到角落
shots.prompt_en: Everyone is busy in the lab; a small safety icon is pushed into a corner. No faces in detail.
shots.narration: 一忙起来，最容易忘的就是安全。
overlay: 人都会犯错，越忙越要守规矩

shots.section_title: 人都会犯错，越忙越要守规矩
shots.scene: 博士帽和老资历徽章旁也有差错图标
shots.prompt_en: A doctoral cap and a senior badge, each with a small error icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 学历再高、资历再老，人都会犯错。

shots.section_title: 人都会犯错，越忙越要守规矩
shots.scene: 抄近路跳过防护步骤的箭头被打叉，绕回正路
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut arrow skipping a protection step is crossed out, and the path returns to the proper route. No people.
shots.narration: 越忙越想抄近路，越要按规矩来。

shots.scene: 时钟指针飞转，阿杰额头冒汗
shots.prompt_en: Clock hands spin fast while the young male student sweats.
shots.narration: 图省事，往往是因为赶时间。

shots.scene: 实验计划表上留出空白的余量时段
shots.prompt_en: A blank experiment schedule with buffer time blocks left empty between tasks. No people.
shots.narration: 实验计划留余量，不靠抢时间。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下来深呼吸，再继续
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses, takes a deep breath, then continues calmly.
shots.narration: 一着急，就先停一停，安全步骤不省。

shots.scene: 阿杰的样品被洗掉，他气得握拳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds his samples washed away and clenches his fist in anger.
shots.narration: 阿杰气坏了。

shots.scene: 一拳捶向纸巾盒，手被划破的图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a fist hitting a tissue box dispenser and a small cut on the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 一拳捶下去，手被划破了。

shots.scene: 阿杰走到走廊冷静，深呼吸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps into the corridor to calm down and breathes deeply.
shots.narration: 生气时先离开冷静，别拿东西撒气。

shots.section_title: 专注：别一边看手机一边操作
shots.scene: 开车时边吃边聊、调收音机的图标，只有目视前方打勾
shots.prompt_en: Driving icons: eating, chatting and tuning the radio are crossed out; eyes on the road gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 开车时，只有盯着路面才不算分心。
overlay: 专注：别一边看手机一边操作

shots.section_title: 专注：别一边看手机一边操作
shots.scene: 边看手机边移液的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person pipetting while looking at a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 做实验也一样，别边看手机边操作。

shots.section_title: 专注：别一边看手机一边操作
shots.scene: 推着试剂车走楼道，手机收在口袋里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a chemical cart down a corridor with his phone in his pocket.
shots.narration: 推试剂车、走楼道，也别看手机。

shots.section_title: 关注人的因素：疲劳和马虎
shots.scene: 疲劳的电池、走神的气泡、马虎的问号三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a low battery, a wandering thought bubble, and a careless question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 人会累，会走神，会马虎。
overlay: 关注人的因素：疲劳和马虎

shots.section_title: 关注人的因素：疲劳和马虎
shots.scene: 不同的小人图标，各有不同的状态
shots.prompt_en: Several different person pictograms, each with a different mood or energy icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人都不一样，状态也会变。

shots.section_title: 关注人的因素：疲劳和马虎
shots.scene: 王老师和学生交谈，引导大家
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks with students, guiding them kindly.
shots.narration: 管理者要会影响人的行为和观念。

shots.scene: 老周看着一瓶熟悉的试剂，旁边已用多年的日历
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a familiar reagent bottle beside a calendar showing many years.
shots.narration: 认知陷阱，连老手也会中招。

shots.scene: 多年没出事的勾勾，旁边危险图标被缩小
shots.prompt_en: A long row of checkmarks for years without incidents, while a hazard icon beside them shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 多年没出事，就低估了危险。

shots.scene: 一份空白安全说明书，只看第一行就合上
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet is closed after reading only the first line, while later sections stay unread. No people.
shots.narration: 只看第一眼，不往下读，也是陷阱。

shots.scene: 表面打勾的清单下方藏着一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with all boxes ticked on the surface, with a hidden warning triangle beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 表面条件满足，不等于真的安全。

shots.scene: 嬉闹、不戴护目镜两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two crossed-out pictograms: horseplay in the lab, and working without goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 人做出的危险动作，叫不安全行为。

shots.scene: 明知规程却图省事，跳过一步的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person knowingly skipping a written step to save time, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 明知规程却图省事，也是不安全行为。

shots.scene: 饼图里人的行为占一大块，管理和设备各一块
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart where human behavior is the largest slice, with management and equipment slices too. No people.
shots.narration: 多数事故与人有关，也要查管理和设备。

shots.scene: 纸箱堵着通道，旁边高温热板无人看
shots.prompt_en: Boxes block an aisle and a hot plate sits unattended nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 环境里让人受伤的隐患，叫不安全状态。

shots.scene: 乱拉的延长线、没标签的瓶子、堵住的门口三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tangled extension cord, an unlabeled bottle, and a blocked doorway. No people.
shots.narration: 乱拉线、堵门口、没标签，都是。

shots.scene: 敞开的地沟盖板被围挡，旁边警示标志
shots.prompt_en: An open floor trench cover is fenced off with a warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 敞开的盖板，先围挡、再报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱搬离通道，再给王老师打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the boxes out of the aisle, then calls the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 能纠正马上纠正，纠正不了就报告。

shots.scene: 两条岔路：一条明知危险还走，一条蒙着眼走
shots.prompt_en: Two paths: one with a person walking past a warning sign knowingly, the other with a blindfolded person. No people.
shots.narration: 出事往往两种：明知故犯，或不知危险。

shots.scene: 规程册里每一条都连着一个过去的事故图标
shots.prompt_en: A procedure binder where each line links back to a past accident icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程写下的，都是用教训换来的。

shots.scene: 不守规范的场景亮起红灯
shots.prompt_en: A red warning light glows over a scene of procedures being ignored. No people.
shots.narration: 事故最常发生在不守规范的时候。

shots.section_title: 差错是系统问题的症状
shots.scene: 地面上的一朵小花是差错，地下是庞大的根系
shots.prompt_en: A small weed above the ground labeled as an error, with a large root system underground. No people.
shots.narration: 人犯错，往往是系统出了问题。
overlay: 差错是系统问题的症状

shots.section_title: 差错是系统问题的症状
shots.scene: 根系分成三支：管理、个人、环境条件
shots.prompt_en: The roots split into three branches with icons: management, the individual, and environment conditions. No people.
shots.narration: 差错是症状，根子在下面。

shots.section_title: 差错是系统问题的症状
shots.scene: 老周管制度、阿杰守规、老李修设施
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews rules, the young male student follows the procedure, and the facility engineer repairs equipment.
shots.narration: 管理、个人、设施，三方都有责任。

shots.section_title: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
shots.scene: 几片带洞的奶酪片排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Several cheese slices with holes stand in a row like defense layers. No people.
shots.narration: 每道防线都有漏洞，像一片片奶酪。
overlay: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事

shots.section_title: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
shots.scene: 一支箭头穿过对齐的洞，撞上事故图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow passes through aligned holes in all slices and hits an accident icon. No people.
shots.narration: 漏洞刚好对齐，事故就发生了。

shots.section_title: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
shots.scene: 最后一片奶酪上的洞标为一线失误
shots.prompt_en: The last cheese slice's hole is highlighted as a frontline mistake. No people.
shots.narration: 一线的失误，是看得见的漏洞。

shots.section_title: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
shots.scene: 前面几片的暗洞：时钟、缺培训、坏设备
shots.prompt_en: Hidden holes in the earlier slices show a clock, a missing training icon, and a broken equipment icon. No people.
shots.narration: 赶进度、缺培训、设备坏，是暗洞。

shots.section_title: 瑞士奶酪模型：漏洞对齐就出事
shots.scene: 补上一个洞，箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: One hole is patched and the arrow is stopped by the slice. No people.
shots.narration: 堵上任何一个洞，事故就能挡住。

shots.section_title: 事故金字塔：险情是事故的预告
shots.scene: 金字塔：顶端一个重伤，中间多个轻伤，底部大量险情
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid: one serious injury icon at the top, several minor injury icons in the middle, and many near-miss icons at the base. No people.
shots.narration: 一次重伤背后，有很多轻伤和险情。
overlay: 事故金字塔：险情是事故的预告

shots.section_title: 事故金字塔：险情是事故的预告
shots.scene: 金字塔最底部是大量不安全行为和状态
shots.prompt_en: Below the pyramid base lie many unsafe act and unsafe condition icons. No people.
shots.narration: 最底下，是大量不安全行为和状态。

shots.section_title: 事故金字塔：险情是事故的预告
shots.scene: 阿杰把一次险情记下来，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes down a near miss and hands it to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 报告险情，在塔底就把事故拦住。

shots.scene: 冰山：水面上的一角是医药费
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg with a small tip above water showing a medical bill icon. No people.
shots.narration: 事故的代价像冰山，医药费只是一角。

shots.scene: 水下是停课、设备损坏、数据丢失、多年心血
shots.prompt_en: Below the water: icons of a cancelled class, broken equipment, lost data, and years of work. No people.
shots.narration: 受伤、损坏、停课，可能毁掉多年积累。

shots.scene: 书本和盾牌，把事故图标挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A book and a shield keep an accident icon away. No people.
shots.narration: 多数事故能预防，懂安全就能少出事。

shots.scene: 两个岔开的箭头：无心之失与有意违规
shots.prompt_en: Two diverging arrows: one labeled with an oops icon, one with a deliberate shortcut icon. No people.
shots.narration: 差错分两类，对策不一样。

shots.scene: 拿错瓶、漏一步的图标，旁边检查表和好设计
shots.prompt_en: Icons of picking the wrong bottle and missing a step, next to a checklist and a well designed rack. No people.
shots.narration: 拿错瓶、漏一步，靠检查表和设计防。

shots.scene: 故意走捷径的图标，检查表管不住
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a deliberate shortcut walking past a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 故意走捷径，检查表管不住。

shots.scene: 培训、清楚的规程、团队文化三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a training session, a clear procedure sheet, and a team culture circle. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠培训、清楚的规程和文化。

shots.section_title: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
shots.scene: 三个门牌：无心差错、没意识到风险、明知危险硬干
shots.prompt_en: Three signboards with icons: an honest slip, an unaware person, and a reckless person. No people.
shots.narration: 行为分三类，处理各不同。
overlay: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对

shots.section_title: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
shots.scene: 抄错数的阿杰，老周改流程而不是批评
shots.prompt_en: The young male student copied a wrong number; the older man revises the procedure form instead of scolding him.
shots.narration: 无心差错：不责备，改进流程系统。

shots.section_title: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
shots.scene: 小研辅导阿杰，把安全做法放到更顺手的位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student coaches the young male student and moves the safety gear to a handier spot.
shots.narration: 没意识到风险：辅导他，让安全更方便。

shots.section_title: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
shots.scene: 明知危险还硬干的图标被打叉，旁边问责图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of someone knowingly doing a dangerous shortcut, crossed out, with an accountability gavel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 明知危险还硬干，要严肃问责。

shots.section_title: 公正文化：三类行为，三种应对
shots.scene: 险情报告箱里的报告越来越多
shots.prompt_en: A near-miss report box filling up with more and more blank reports. No people.
shots.narration: 诚实的失误不责备，险情报告才会多。

shots.section_title: 按人的特点设计：防错设计
shots.scene: 人和墙的对比：别跟人性较劲
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person pushing against a wall, crossed out, next to a smooth path designed around them. No people.
shots.narration: 别跟人性较劲，按人的特点设计。
overlay: 按人的特点设计：防错设计

shots.section_title: 按人的特点设计：防错设计
shots.scene: 【实拍】废液桶口的颜色和形状各不相同，漏斗只能插进对应的桶（清水模拟，无品牌，无人）
shots.prompt_en: Waste containers with different colored and shaped openings; a funnel only fits the matching container. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色加形状，漏斗只插得进对的桶。

shots.section_title: 按人的特点设计：防错设计
shots.scene: 醒目标签、分开存放、开关防误触罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bold label, separated storage shelves, and a switch with a protective flip cover. No people.
shots.narration: 标签醒目、分开存放，开关加防护罩。

shots.section_title: 按人的特点设计：防错设计
shots.scene: 流程中加入核对的勾选点，干扰和催促图标变小
shots.prompt_en: A workflow with a double-check point added, while distraction and rush icons shrink. No people.
shots.narration: 流程加核对，少干扰，少赶工压力。

shots.scene: 五个E图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a book, a thumbs up, a gear, a rule book, and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 预防事故，有五个E。

shots.scene: 王老师讲课、老周表扬阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a class, and the older man praises the young male student.
shots.narration: 教育靠培训，激励靠表扬和奖励。

shots.scene: 通风柜和防护罩安装好，规章制度严格执行
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood and a machine guard are installed, and a rule book is enforced at the lab door.
shots.narration: 工程上防护，制度上严格执行。

shots.scene: 放大镜检查效果，循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass reviews results, with a continuous improvement loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 最后评估效果，持续改进。

shots.scene: 人脑和忙碌时钟
shots.prompt_en: A human brain icon next to a rushing clock.
shots.narration: 人都会犯错，忙、累、急最危险。

shots.scene: 奶酪片和金字塔
shots.prompt_en: Cheese slices and a pyramid of near misses.
shots.narration: 差错是系统的症状，险情要报告。

shots.scene: 三类行为和防错设计
shots.prompt_en: Three behavior signboards and an error-proof funnel.
shots.narration: 三类行为三种应对，用设计防错。

shots.scene: 欣欣在骨牌阵旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the row of dominoes.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲实验室危害的类型。
